title: The IAAA Model — Foundation of IAM
objective: Study-guide review — CISSP — Domain 5: Identity and Access Management (IAM): The IAAA Model — Foundation of IAM.

items: Identification — User claims an identity (username, email, account number)
Authentication — System verifies the claimed identity (password, biometric, token)
Authorization — System grants appropriate access based on verified identity
Accountability — System tracks and logs all user actions for audit

blocks.text: The IAAA model is the conceptual foundation for ALL identity and access management:

rows: Entering a password, scanning a fingerprint
ACL grants read access to a file

items: Identification without authentication is meaningless (anyone can claim to be admin)
Authentication without authorization is useless (verified identity but no access decisions)
Authorization without accountability is dangerous (access granted but no record of actions)
All four must work together for a complete IAM system

blocks.title: Exam trap
blocks.text: ⚠️ Exam Trap: The exam tests IAAA as a sequence. Identification ALWAYS comes first (claim identity), followed by authentication (verify claim), then authorization (grant access), then accountability (log actions). Know the order.
